profile.summary: Senior QA Engineer with 9 years of experience building test automation frameworks for enterprise security platforms. Expertise in multi-cloud security testing across AWS, Azure, and GCP, with deep knowledge of L3-L7 network protocols. Currently pursuing an M.Tech in AI/ML at BITS Pilani to advance ML-driven security automation and threat detection.

responsibilities: Designed and executed 500+ functional, integration, and regression test scenarios for cloud firewall features across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Built an end-to-end Python + Robot Framework solution achieving 85% automation coverage for security policies.
Implemented Behave BDD suites for threat-detection workflows, improving readability for cross-functional teams.
Validated L3-L7 firewall and IDS/IPS functionality across protocols, traffic patterns, and rule configurations.
Containerized test infrastructure with Docker and Kubernetes, reducing execution time by 40%.
Developed Python automation for HTTP, HTTPS, and HTTP/2 protocol compliance, ensuring adherence to 15+ RFC standards.
Built a high-performance Origin testing tool handling 300,000+ concurrent requests with 99.9% reliability.
Identified critical memory leaks with LeakSanitizer, preventing three potential production security vulnerabilities.
Automated TLS compliance validation across certificate configurations and cipher suites.
Reduced regression testing time by 28% through Python and Selenium automation optimization.
Developed and maintained 200+ automated test cases for enterprise backup and recovery solutions.
Collaborated with development teams to introduce shift-left testing, reducing bug escape rate by 15%.
